scene.note: The till screen shows whatever is in Anjali's stock list, however long it gets.

steps.note: Anjali adds a new item at the end of her stock list.
The list gets every item as a prop.
One line per item appears on the till screen, with its name and price.
Each line on the screen stands for one item of stock.
An item sells out or a new one arrives, and the list is drawn again.
Every item keeps its own line, because each line is named after its item.
Some items in the stock list have none left.
The list leaves those out before drawing.
Visitors only see what they can buy.
The stock list is in the order Anjali added things.
The list puts its own copy in order of price and leaves Anjali's list as it is.
Parents find the cheapest thing at the top.
